name: application_submit
description: Protected, two-step. Submit an application for the open service. The first call changes nothing and returns a summary to read back; after a clear yes, call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id. The result has the decision, its reason and the review route.

fields_json.description: JSON object with the service's fields from service_open

on_behalf_of.description: Acting for a child: the child's resident number, or just the child's first name (it is matched only among the caller's own recorded children).

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
